//: PRODUCTION configuration for the Auth API. docker-compose.yml mounts this over /app/appsettings.json, and the image build deletes the published one - so this file is the COMPLETE runtime configuration, not an overlay. Keys prefixed with // are documentation; the .NET configuration binder ignores them. Prefer environment variables for secrets: ASP.NET Core maps __ to :, e.g. ConnectionStrings__MainDbConnection.
//AllowedCORSOrigin: ORIGINS ONLY - scheme + host + optional port, no path. Replace YOUR_DOMAIN with the public origin the browser loads, e.g. https://apps.example.com. A path such as https://apps.example.com/myapp/api-auth is a URL, not an origin, and will never match.
//LocalIdentity: Policy for the built-in identity provider (UserAccounts table, hashed with ASP.NET Core PasswordHasher). Raise MinPasswordLength for anything real, and set AllowSelfRegistration to false for internal apps.
//ExternalIdp: Optional 'sign in with...' slot, shipped OFF and empty. Set Enabled plus a provider's Enabled/ClientId/ClientSecret/Authority to switch it on, and point RedirectUri at this API's /api/Auth/ExternalCallback. Keep ClientSecret out of source control (use ExternalIdp__Providers__Google__ClientSecret). Google authority: https://accounts.google.com. Microsoft: https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/v2.0. GitHub has no discovery document, so set its three endpoint overrides instead of Authority.
//Sentry: Leave Dsn empty to keep error reporting switched off.
